goal: Run one bounded Misaya Notes UI optimization phase and one feature-oracle item until evidence proves pass, block, or fail.
done_when: Selected phase report exists with command, browser, compliance, rollback, and acceptance evidence or blocker notes.
Selected feature-oracle item has status passing, blocked, or waived with evidence or notes.
Source packet and continuity ledger contain current code facts and boundary decisions.
Progress log and agent handoff name the next concrete action.
continue_when: The target phase still has unchecked acceptance gates.
Required validation can run inside the phase boundary.
stop_when: Production deployment, migration, destructive git action, or provider change is required.
A needed edit path is outside the phase boundary.
A public/private content boundary is ambiguous.
